blocks.task_summary: Differentiate g(x) = e^(x^2+1) using the chain rule, then evaluate the derivative at x = -1.
method_path: Differentiate g(x) = e^(x^2 + 1) using the chain rule: g'(x) = 2x e^(x^2 + 1)
Substitute x = -1 into g'(x) to obtain g'(-1) = 2(-1) e^((-1)^2 + 1) = -2e^2

evidence.basis: g'(x) = 2x e^(x^2+1) awarded (A2); substitute x = -1 into their derivative (M1); g'(-1) = -2e^2 awarded A1. Total 4 marks.
